resources.string: See which apps use your internet — and stop the ones that shouldn\'t.
SecureBox needs usage access to read per-app traffic. The data stays on this device and is never uploaded.
Your TV\'s settings app did not open automatically. Open Settings → Apps → Special app access → Usage access, then allow SecureBox. On some boxes it is called “Usage statistics”.
Runs entirely on this device. No traffic is sent to SecureBox.
Another VPN is active. Android allows one VPN at a time, so the firewall cannot start until it is turned off.
Blocks everything installed outside the Play Store, including sideloaded TV apps.
Refreshes every 2 seconds. Shows every app with traffic since the last boot; the rate is the activity since the previous refresh.
Totals for the selected period, read from Android\'s own statistics.
No per-app traffic is visible yet. Make sure usage access is granted, use the internet for a moment, then refresh.
Apps listening on a port can accept connections from other devices on your network. “Internet-facing” ports are reachable beyond this device; “Local only” ports are limited to this device.
Android restricts /proc/net on this version, so listening ports cannot be listed. This is a platform limit, not a clean result.
No app is listening on a port.
Compares each app\'s upload in the last hour with its 7-day hourly average. It is a prompt to check the app, not proof of wrongdoing.
No check has run yet. SecureBox checks hourly when the app is installed.
%1$s uploaded %2$s in an hour (usually %3$s per hour).
SecureBox could not get VPN permission. The firewall needs it to block apps locally.
The firewall service could not start. Try again.
